item.title: OpenRouter 实测 RAG 重排序：274 题基准中 precision@1 从 81% 提升到 97% / Reranking in RAG: How to Fix Bad Retrieval with a Reranker
item.description: When a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) app gives wrong answers even though the right information is in your documents, retrieval is often the cause. Vector search is great at finding chunks on the right topic, but it often falls for near misses, like pulling the bucket limit for the Enterprise plan when the user asked about the Growth plan. Reranking in RAG fixes this by taking your vector search’s top 30 candidates and passing them through a dedicated cross-encoder model that re-scores eac（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: 研究称中国最强 AI 模型由被禁运的 Nvidia Blackwell 芯片训练 / Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
item.description: TechCrunch 报道，前 OpenAI 研究员 Will DePue 分析 DeepSeek、月之暗面、MiniMax 和蚂蚁集团开源模型权重后，称 Kimi K3 与 DeepSeek V4 等模型留有 Blackwell 芯片训练痕迹，而这些芯片被禁止出口到中国。（TechCrunch：AI（RSS））

item.title: WSJ 报道称黄仁勋被罢免更多源于 Nvidia 高风险业务而非私生活 / Jensen Huang's ouster likely traces back to Nvidia's risky business practices more than his personal life
item.description: The Decoder 援引 WSJ 报道分析称，黄仁勋被罢免更多源于 Nvidia 高风险业务而非私生活传闻。Nvidia 在其主导下向 AI 云厂商和数据中心开发商提供数十亿美元财务担保以换取营收分成，最大一笔涉及对 OpenAI 俄亥俄数据中心的 2500 亿美元担保，消息公布后股价跌 5%，临时 CEO Colette Kress 将该承诺减半。（The Decoder：AI News（RSS））

item.title: Nvidia 危机与 Anthropic IPO 前夜的 Cerebral Valley AI Summit 现场观察 / Nvidia Crises, Anthropic IPO & Off-the-Charts Demand Have the AI World in a Tizzy
item.description: Newcomer 在旧金山 Cerebral Valley AI Summit 现场报道：Jensen Huang 因第二段婚外情披露辞职，Reuters 当天报道存在第三段，与会者多认为 Nvidia 短期无碍但生态承压，Databricks CEO 称其对整个生态是打击。（Newcomer 新闻长文（RSS））
